simple.tokenizer: sorted Unicode codepoints; universal newlines; vocabulary 94

prior_smoke_exposure.interpretation: Seed101 remains fixed-protocol evaluation with prior smoke exposure. Seed211 is separately reported untouched confirmation. Final-run life sealing precedes final outcome generation.

cost.excludes: compile, fitting/readout, fault gates and two post-run integrity diagnostic replays

result_interpretation.acquired_choice_change: Both fitted lives choose PUSH at all 32 development/evaluation states; initial weights choose HOLD at all 32.
result_interpretation.fixed_push_control: All fitted-life choices and selected branch outcomes equal the fixed PUSH control.
result_interpretation.conditional_action_failure: The measured future winner on both fresh bodies and seeds is PUSH at checkpoints 1/32 and BRAKE at 128/384. Fitting does not acquire that conditional BRAKE choice.
result_interpretation.adaptation: HeVLM fitting changes scores at every evaluation state but changes no selected action from its frozen SimpleLLM parent.
result_interpretation.regret: Difference from the best measured one-intervention plus HOLD-continuation branch, not a global optimum.
result_interpretation.evaluation: Fixed common-state readout of actual executed branch outcomes; this experiment does not train the body along a rollout controlled by the fitted life.

state_consequence_encoding.loss_numeric_encoding: Round-trip F32 decimal values emitted by C; action winners retain all exact ties.

readout_encoding.metric_numeric_encoding: C-computed F32 losses and double action differences, retained from raw JSONL

postrun_integrity_repair.method: Exact-binary isolated replay matched all deterministic rows and 24 saved artifacts. Original already-recorded timing/RSS summary retained; complete candidate SHA equals the original per-cohort SHA. Authenticated replacement used fsync and atomic rename.

red_gate.message: persisted diagnostic trace identity changed: hevlm-s73-diagnostic.jsonl

post_measurement_verifier.purpose: Final persisted trace identity, summary, complete host-step and restored-state parity recheck, added after the observed artifact failure.
